name: CEM-MitoLab
paper_citation: Conrad R & Narayan K (2023) Instance segmentation of mitochondria in electron microscopy images with a generalist deep learning model trained on a diverse dataset. Cell Systems 14(1):58-71.e5. PMID 36657391, PMC9883049. Preprint: https://doi.org/10.1101/2022.03.17.484806

image_sets.name: CEM-MitoLab 2D image patches + mitochondrial instance label maps
image_sets.xy_pixel_size_nm: variable (heterogeneous sources; not given per image in EMPIAR; paper: source volumes with pixel size >40 nm excluded; per-image metadata in cem_mitolab_metadata.xlsx)
image_sets.xy_dimensions_px: mostly 224 x 224; some 512 x 512; some smaller
image_sets.z_slices: n/a (2D); 21,860 image/mask pairs (EMPIAR counts 43,720 files = images + masks)

EMPIAR imageset 1 has a frame range 0-255 and dimensions 4927x785 that look like data-entry artefacts. Per-set GB sizes not available from API except estimate for TNFa FIB TIFs.

label_details: Yes (03_models). label_details: Yes. Datasets 1-3: 10-class organelle class label volume (e.g. MITOS, LDS, EARLYENDO, LATEENDO, GOLGI, NUC, CYTOSKEL, ER, PLASMEM, VESC; Set2 includes CHROMATIN instead of GOLGI; class ID mapping in '* CLASS IDS.txt') + RF membrane probability maps (0-1). Dataset 4: mito class mask + SR mask. Test ROI: human + U-Net mito annotations and 6 ML model membrane predictions.

top_level_entries: DATASET1_Overview/ (contains Set1_-_AIVE_SOURCE_DATA/ with Dataset1_overview.tif 1.4G, labels 47M, CLASS IDS.txt - duplicate subset of Set1)
DATASET4_Muscle/ (contains Set4_-_AIVE_SOURCE_DATA/ with Dataset4_MitoClasss.tif, Dataset4_overview.tif - duplicates)
download.url_encoding_note: File/dir names contain spaces and parentheses; URL-encode (space=%20, '(' and ')' usually fine). Example: https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/empiar/world_availability/12885/data/Set1_-_AIVE_SOURCE_DATA/Dataset1_overview%20-%20ORGANELLE%20CLASS%20LABELS.tif

notes: EXCEEDS 30 GB (32.8 GB total; sum of listed files ~32.6 GB). ~22 GB of that is RF *_MembranePredictions.tif; raw overview + CLAHE + class labels for Sets 1-3 is ~9.8 GB (raw + labels only ~4.8 GB) - scripts can selectively skip MembranePredictions and duplicate DATASET1_Overview/ and DATASET4_Muscle/ folders. EMPIAR pixel widths here (3.2552, 6.5104, 16.0) are in nm (paper: 3.255 nm/px), unlike most entries which use Angstrom. EMPIAR record lists journal as bioRxiv but DOI is the JCB paper. Paper reports two muscle datasets; EMPIAR has one muscle overview (Dataset 4).
